note: B05, B08, B10 and B12 show Blender Python (run inside Blender through the MCP) in a source-view card, not in a Godot editor reconstruction; their exact excerpts and result beats are under source_views. The snapshot is a git archive written with core.autocrlf=true, so text files there have CRLF line endings; hashes are of those bytes.

components.explanation: The three props: the Blender Python Claude Code ran through the MCP (build_*.py, in run order, plus the headless export_crystal.py), the saved .blend sources, and the exported .glb files with their Godot import settings.
The Godot 3D prop room: floor, one light, a camera, WorldEnvironment, the three props at y = 0 and the mage Sprite3D (mage_idle.png, pixel size 0.0226563, Y-billboard; its import kept lossless).
test_a3_assets.gd: loads each .glb and the prop room headlessly and compares them with numbers copied from CHANGE-BRIEF.md (22 checks, exit 1 on any failure).

The recorded run prints 22 checks / 0 failures; the size lines show measured X × Y × Z equal to the brief values copied into the script; headless, so it proves bounds and settings, not looks.

source_views.text:
# Bake: lowest face exactly horizontal facing -Z, then the turn around Z (keeps that face horizontal).
low = min(me.polygons, key=lambda p: p.normal.z)
q = low.normal.rotation_difference(Vector((0, 0, -1)))
me.transform(Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(ROT_Z_DEG), 4, "Z") @ q.to_matrix().to_4x4())
me.update()

xs, ys, zs = zip(*(v.co for v in me.vertices))
dims = (max(xs) - min(xs), max(ys) - min(ys), max(zs) - min(zs))
s = tuple(t / d for t, d in zip(TARGET, dims))
ob.scale = s
ob.rotation_euler = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
source_views.observation: Revision 1 look render: the stones overlap as one mass; fit 1.000 (the first build needed X 1.19, Y 1.12).

tip_i = max(range(len(me.vertices)), key=lambda i: me.vertices[i].co.z)
tip_before = ob.matrix_world @ me.vertices[tip_i].co
length_before = me.vertices[tip_i].co.z
k = (TIP_X - ob.matrix_world.translation.x) / (tip_before.x - ob.matrix_world.translation.x)
for v in me.vertices:
    v.co.z *= k
me.update()

source_views.text:
# Bake: axis along X, then turn about X until a side face points exactly up.
me.transform(Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(90.0), 4, "Y"))
me.update()
sides = [p for p in me.polygons if len(p.vertices) == 4]
up = max(sides, key=lambda p: p.normal.z)
q = up.normal.rotation_difference(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
me.transform(q.to_matrix().to_4x4())
